name: wing-workspace
//: Root of the pnpm workspace. Private: it aggregates the TypeScript packages (extensions/vscode today; packages/* and apps/* next) and owns the single lockfile. See docs/dev/vscode-extension.md §9.3.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json && pnpm -r run format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json && pnpm -r run format:check
